page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities and weaker single-core execution. In stress-ng and Geekbench testing, single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores, consistently rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also demonstrate average performance, matching the middle 50% tier.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is its reliance on older Intel Xeon architecture, which limits single-threaded efficiency but offers stable, dedicated multi-core capacity. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a high density of dedicated physical cores and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, making it a viable option for workloads that scale horizontally across multiple threads rather than demanding high single-core clock speeds. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, database operations, and moderate software compilation.
